extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders (states, tribes, municipalities, industry, NGOs, attorneys, and members of the public) tracking Clean Water Act federal actions and seeking to submit or review notices, proposed rules, guidance, ICRs, and consent decrees
extracted.subtask_description: A search-results listing of Federal Register documents matching 'clean water act,' showing titles, abstracts/excerpts, publication dates, and links for proposed rules, rules, notices, and other Federal Register items related to CWA implementation and enforcement. Useful for identifying dockets that invite public comment or contain substantive regulatory requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comment solicitation periods and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices and ICRs specify timeframes and processes for submitting written feedback (e.g., 'This notice allows for 60 days for public comments').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies solicit comments on specific aspects of proposed information collections, guidance, proposed rules, and consent decrees prior to submission to OMB or final decision-making; comments are submitted to the docket or addresses specified in the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Collection Request (ICR) submission under the Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA)
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA will submit ICRs (e.g., Establishing No-Discharge Zones ICR) to OMB for review and approval in accordance with the PRA and requests public comment beforehand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before submitting an ICR to OMB, EPA solicits comments on specific aspects of the proposed information collection and provides a comment period (often 60 days). The ICR description includes OMB control numbers and current approval expiration dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Capability Assessment (FCA) Guidance standards
rubrics_metrics.description: The FCA Guidance provides information on how to assess a community's financial capability as part of negotiating implementation schedules under permits and enforcement agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance identifies specific methodologies (supplementing the 1995 Interim Economic Guidance workbook) to consider economic impacts to public entities when determining water quality standards variances and antidegradation reviews; EPA requests written feedback to determine whether updates are necessary to accurately identify community financial capability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solicitation of stakeholder input via public dockets and listening sessions
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA establishes public dockets and conducts listening sessions (e.g., on Section 401 implementation challenges) to invite written feedback and stakeholder perspectives on regulatory uncertainty or implementation challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agency will use input to determine whether guidance or rulemaking are necessary and solicits comment on specified issues (for example, scope of certification and implementation of section 401(a)(2)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Facility Response Plan (FRP) substantive thresholds and planning distance calculations
rubrics_metrics.description: FRP requirements include criteria for when a concentration of a Clean Water Act hazardous substance (CWA HS) is covered (e.g., concentrations that violate National Primary Drinking Water Standards or State Drinking Water Regulations; compromise PWS compliance; result in adverse health impacts; contaminate public water system infrastructure; or impair taste, odor, or other aesthetic characteristics).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements include planning distance calculations (for the facility) tied to those concentration/impact thresholds and other procedural FRP planning elements; notices seek feedback on implementation challenges and clarifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods Update Rule: approved analytical methods and table updates
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA proposes to add new EPA methods (e.g., for PFAS and PCB congeners), add methods from voluntary consensus bodies, withdraw seven Aroclor parameters, and simplify sampling requirements for certain VOCs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updating approved methods is intended to increase the quality and consistency of data collected for CWA purposes (e.g., NPDES reporting). The proposed rule may modify tables of approved methods but does not itself mandate monitoring or establish discharge limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section 319 grant eligibility and recipient requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The 2024 Section 319 Guidelines describe requirements that apply to recipients (states, territories, D.C.) awarded federal grants under CWA section 319 for nonpoint source management programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revised guidelines replace prior guidance, outline recipient responsibilities for program implementation and grant administration, and aim to advance science, engage communities, and guide the national Nonpoint Source Program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section 404 Tribal and State assumption program minimum requirements and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Final revisions clarify the requirements and processes for Tribes and States to assume and administer a CWA section 404 permitting program for discharges of dredged and fill material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rule clarifies minimum requirements while allowing flexibility to accommodate individual Tribal and State needs, clarifies the criminal negligence standard in the section 404 program (and a corresponding change in section 402), and makes technical revisions and updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consent decree notice and public input prior to settling litigation
rubrics_metrics.description: When EPA/DOJ propose consent decrees resolving CWA-related litigation, the agency publishes notices inviting public input on the proposed settlement before final decision-making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices summarize allegations (e.g., failures to promulgate water quality standards or NPDES violations), the proposed consent decree terms (injunctive relief, remedial projects, penalties), and provide information on submitting comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of lodging of proposed consent decree content and remedial obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: Lodging notices describe the complaint, alleged violations of the Clean Water Act, and the nature of obligations in the proposed consent decree (e.g., implementation of long-term control plans, capital improvements, pollution control equipment, injunctive relief, and civil penalties).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These notices inform the public and affected parties of settlement terms and allow them to review and comment during the prescribed period.

rubrics_metrics.name: No-Discharge Zones (NDZs) establishment ICR specifics
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA proposes an ICR for the process of establishing NDZs under CWA section 312, renewing the prior information collection (with EPA ICR Number and OMB Control Number provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice describes the scope of the ICR, indicates current approval status/expiration, and solicits public comments on the information collection as required by PRA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transfer of Confidential Business Information (CBI) to contractors — notice and comment
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA intends to transfer CBI collected under CWA authorities (e.g., section 308) to contractors and their subcontractors (e.g., ICF International) to assist with preparation of effluent guidelines and related activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The agency provides a notice of intended transfer and invites interested persons to submit comments on the transfer and related terms, including dates and contact information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updated definition of 'Waters of the United States' (WOTUS) — scope and objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies propose revising the regulations defining the scope of waters federally covered under the CWA to provide greater regulatory certainty and increase program predictability and consistency in light of the Supreme Court's Sackett decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed rule seeks to implement the CWA objective to restore and maintain water quality while respecting State and Tribal authority; the proposal describes statutory and policy bases, and invites public comment on scope and implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory-burden and small-entity impact considerations for timing changes
rubrics_metrics.description: When proposing delays to compliance dates or other timing changes (e.g., delaying compliance date for FRP requirements), agencies assess whether the action imposes new regulatory burdens on small entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies may conclude that a mere delay of a compliance date does not impose a regulatory burden (and thus has no new small-entity impacts) because the underlying rule remains unchanged; such analyses reference prior Federal Register statements and small-entity compliance considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of interim economic methodologies to inform WQS variances and antidegradation reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: FCA and WQS guidance reference methodologies (e.g., Interim Economic Guidance for Water Quality Standards (1995) workbook) to consider economic impacts to public entities when determining variances, antidegradation decisions, and designated use revisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These methodologies supplement agency guidance and, in appropriate cases, inform decisions about revisions to designated uses and implementation schedules; EPA seeks input on methodological clarity and applicability.
